about_the_game:
Become the Zoomcat and Chase Down Viruses at Light Speed!

Boot up the Zoomcat, the internet's fastest feline antivirus! Swiftly navigate the neon circuits of cyberspace at the breakneck speeds needed to hunt down the sneaky viruses threatening to sow chaos across the net.

Fast-Paced Parkour Action

Zoomcat is a 2D side-scrolling platformer where precision and speed are everything. Jump, slide, dash, and chain together stylish combos to build momentum and outpace viruses in electrifying cat-and-mouse chases. Every move counts—miss a beat and the critters will escape!

Features

  • 40+ handcrafted levels packed with unique layouts, tricky obstacles, and increasingly cunning viruses.

  • Momentum-based gameplay: Perform the fluid combos needed to keep pace with your foes

  • Parkour controls: jump across firewalls, slide under barriers, and dash through data streams.

  • Challenging enemies: viruses come in many forms—fast, evasive, and relentless. Adapt your moves to catch them all.

  • Global leaderboards: compete with players around the world for the fastest times and highest scores. Will you become the ultimate protector of cyberspace?

  • Replayability: master each level to perfect your runs, climb the ranks, and discover hidden tricks that shave off seconds.

Your Mission

Clean up the corrupted net, restore digital order, and prove you’re the only cat fast enough to keep the internet safe. The faster you are, the higher you climb!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4-compliant onboard graphics
  • Storage: 30 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card
  • Storage: 30 MB available space

short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer in which you play as the titular antivirus Zoomcat - dashing, leaping and sliding across cyberspace to catch ever more agile and clever viruses. Will you be the fastest cat on the leaderboards?
